source_title: Follow the Dissonance, Then Follow the Funder
summary: This first founding-members livestream is a high-pressure method and control-source: Jiang demonstrates Predictive History as dissonance, actor-mapping, funder-mapping, and memory filtering, while also extending current Section 224 forever-war, AI-infrastructure bailout, surveillance-state, DEI-as-class-fragmentation, and 1920s/Depression forecast families.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The read's strongest method marks explain that Jiang starts from dissonance, asks who organized and funded a story, and abstracts away from personalities into the real game.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Game Theory already owns the portable player, rules, incentives, and payoff method. This source adds a live-demonstration layer rather than a new method page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says he has no secret sources and is showing how he watches, interprets, and analyzes the news from ordinary public feeds.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Prediction owns the public method when it becomes auditable: the source is valuable because it exposes the inputs and triage practice behind later forecasts, not because it settles the forecasts themselves.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this June 7, 2026 livestream as the first explicit founding-members live method demonstration: Jiang denies hidden sources, names the lightweight Twitter/YouTube/Google stack, follows dissonance, checks organizers and funders, reads rival spin, and holds possible story lines in memory until patterns connect.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns method exposure when the question is how public-source pattern reading becomes testable forecast practice. Game Theory owns the underlying player/incentive abstraction; Living School owns the interactive classroom/community formation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold this source for a later Living School update as the members-livestream phase: the channel becomes an interactive and experimental public classroom where the audience asks live questions, supplies feedback, and Jiang plans to adjust structure over several months.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Living School owns the formation of a learning community. Prediction owns the method once it becomes forecast discipline; Attention owns livestream/platform dependence only if the surface itself captures the audience.

new_lens_seeds.title: Dissonance As Method
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: An event becomes analytically important when it violates the analyst's standing model; the contradiction then triggers actor-mapping, funder-mapping, rival-argument reading, memory storage, and forecast testing.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source gives the cleanest live demonstration of Jiang's feed triage, but the mechanism can probably be carried by Prediction, Game Theory, and Living School rather than extracted now.

new_lens_seeds.title: Identity Management As Class Counterinsurgency
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Elite institutions redirect class grievance into race, identity, and grievance categories so a broad economic coalition cannot remain a single political body.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism appears here with unusual clarity in the Occupy-to-DEI formulation and likely recurs in Sneako/DEI material, but it needs a concept-cluster review against Proximity Games, Mass Society, Education, Meritocracy, and Bureaucracy before public extraction.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-06-07 source is later than the 2024 psychohistory classroom origin and 2025 Predictive History direct-address origin, so it should not become the origin of Prediction or Living School. It is the first current public source where Jiang explicitly demonstrates the founding-members live-feed method in real time.

The Section 224 passage is a late June 2026 escalation-pressure layer after the March-April Iran-war/chokepoint sequence already established no-exit war, ground-invasion, draft, and domestic-control pressure.

The AI-race reversal is a late recurrence of the Mass Society surveillance-bargain grid: by June 2026 Jiang is saying the oligarchs win because China and America use each other as pretexts to build parallel AI surveillance states.

canon_candidates.candidate: Predictive History live-feed method: no hidden sources are required; the analyst watches ordinary public feeds, notices dissonance, maps organizers and funders, reads counterarguments, stores anomalies in memory, and lets recurring patterns produce testable expectations.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Review against Prediction and Game Theory pages before canon promotion; the canon record should distinguish public-source method from claims that depend on speculative actor/funder inferences.

canon_candidates.candidate: Section 224 commits America permanently to Israel's war environment and makes the Iran ceasefire theater before either false-flag justification or force buildup for ground invasion.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Split legal-integration, U.S.-Israel military obligation, ceasefire-theater, and ground-invasion forecast tests before ledger work; do not treat ordinary alliance support as confirmation of the stronger forever-war claim.

canon_candidates.candidate: The AI bubble can eventually burst, but government will step in to bail out or absorb the infrastructure while insiders control timing and downside exposure.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with existing controlled-implosion and AI-control records; separate state subsidy, public data-center takeover, market-bubble timing, and military-infrastructure hardening.

canon_candidates.candidate: America is in a 1920s/Weimar-like phase and should expect a Great Depression and stock-market collapse.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: This is a concise analogical forecast, not a developed model in this source; promote only after comparison with controlled-implosion, AI-bubble, and depression/collapse forecast families.
